description: Routes each page (or contiguous page-run) of a medical record to the correct specialist analyzer. Multimodal — uses layout + text signatures.

categories.label: discharge-summary
categories.description: Hospital discharge summary. Signals: 'Discharge Summary' header, admit/discharge dates, hospital course, discharge medications.

categories.label: consultation-note
categories.description: Specialist consultation. Signals: 'Consultation' header, referring physician, reason for consultation, HPI, assessment/plan.

categories.label: progress-note
categories.description: Daily progress or SOAP note. Signals: Subjective/Objective/Assessment/Plan headers, daily vitals, hospital-day counter.

categories.label: cardiology-ecg
categories.description: ECG or cardiology report. Signals: Rate, PR, QRS, QT, QTc, Axis, interpretive statements.

categories.label: lab-results
categories.description: Laboratory results — CBC, chemistry, POC, microbiology. Signals: analyte name + value + reference range triples.

categories.label: immunizations
categories.description: Immunization record. Signals: 'Vaccine:' / 'Date Given:' / 'Lot Number:' key-value blocks.

categories.label: intake-output
categories.description: Intake & output flowsheet. Signals: 'Total Intake / Total Output / Fluid Balance', columnar totals.

categories.label: medication-admin-record
categories.description: MAR. Signals: 'Admin Date/Time', 'Medication Name', 'Ingredients', 'Admin Details' key-value groups.

categories.label: pmh-problems
categories.description: Past medical history / problems list. Signals: 'Problem Name', 'Life Cycle Status', 'Onset Date'.

categories.label: orders-admit-transfer
categories.description: Admit/Transfer/Discharge order. Signals: 'Order: Discharge' or 'Order: Admit', 'Order Status'.

categories.label: orders-laboratory
categories.description: Laboratory order. Signals: 'Order:' with lab test name, 'General Laboratory' section.

categories.label: orders-nursing
categories.description: Nursing order. Signals: 'Nursing' section, monitoring/replacement orders.

categories.label: orders-medication
categories.description: Medication order. Signals: 'Medications' section, dose/route/frequency in order details.

categories.label: orders-radiology
categories.description: Imaging order. Signals: 'Radiology' section, modality (CT/MRI/XR/US), contrast.

categories.label: plan-of-care
categories.description: Plan of care / care plan. Signals: 'Plan of Care' header, goals/interventions/outcomes.

categories.label: cover-separator
categories.description: Facility cover page, separator, or blank page. Ignore for extraction.

categories.label: unknown-other
categories.description: Confidence below any specialist. Route to human review.
